repo.name: Megatron-Bridge

detail.body:
## Background

Nightly Megatron-Core bump, main lane. Pins MCore `main` to `de003e9932ce777e5bdcf41ed178c04c8839ec7f` (from `a98aed55`, 12 commits). `.dev.commit` is unchanged.

## What changed

- `.main.commit` and the `3rdparty/Megatron-LM` gitlink now point to `de003e99`.
- `uv.lock` regenerated with `uv lock --upgrade` (uv 0.7.2); `pyproject.toml` unchanged. Seven non-GPU packages moved: markdown, mlflow, mlflow-skinny, mlflow-tracing, openai, starlette, wrapt.
- Gemma4 fix: MCore #7709 removed the `te_checkpoint` re-export from `moe_layer`. `Gemma4MoELayer` recompute now goes through `precision_aware_checkpoint`, matching upstream `MoELayer`. The unit test now monkeypatches `megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine.te_checkpoint`.

## Details

- Locally, `L0_Launch_megatron_fsdp` and Core unit shard 1/3 failed when TE auto-selected FlashAttention 4. Both failures reproduce on the old pin and image. Both pass with CI's FlashAttention policy (`NVTE_FLASH_ATTN_V2=1`, V3/V4=0, from `test-template/action.yml`), so they are not caused by this bump.
- `L0_Launch_recipes_deepseek` skips every case on H100, as in CI: five cases need the DSv4 toy model, which is not in TestData, and one is MXFP8, which needs Blackwell. It is not counted as passed. The MCore delta does not touch DSv4 modules.

## Tested

Local H100 runs on the merge of this head with `main` `535a57a2` (tree `390db483`), using the validation image with diffusion deps:
- Unit: Core shards 0/3, 1/3 and 2/3, plus Diffusion — passed.
- Functional: 39 impact-selected L0/L1/L2 rows passed, covering converter, megatron_fsdp, DeepSeek/Qwen3/Gemma4-VL/Nemotron-Omni models, training (pretrain/finetune/resiliency/checkpointing), GTP conversion, and MLM↔MBridge checkpoints. 33 model-family L1/L2 rows judged unaffected were left to CI.
- `uv lock --check`, `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`: pass.
- Required CI: pending.

Re: review 5518307907, which could not check the checkpoint call because the submodule was not visible.

- **Pinned helper:** at MCore `de003e9932ce777e5bdcf41ed178c04c8839ec7f`, `megatron/core/transformer/utils.py:607` defines `precision_aware_checkpoint(function, config, tp_group, /, *args, distribute_saved_activations=False, **kwargs)`.
  - When `config.fp8 or config.fp4` is set, it lazily imports `megatron.core.extensions.transformer_engine.te_checkpoint` and calls `te_checkpoint(function, False, tensor_parallel.random.get_cuda_rng_tracker, tp_group, *args)`.
  - Otherwise it calls `tensor_parallel.checkpoint(function, False, *args)`.
  - These are the same calls the removed `Gemma4MoELayer` branch made.
- **Unit test:** the test now monkeypatches `te_checkpoint` at that lazy-import location. Its BF16, FP8 and FP4 assertions are unchanged.
- **Local H100 runs on this tree:**
  - `test_moe_layer_recompute_uses_expected_checkpoint_for_training[fp8]` and `[fp4]` passed in Core unit shard 0/3 (4050 passed).
  - `[bf16]` passed in Core unit shard 1/3 (4024 passed).
- **Scope:** this PR covers only the main lane. `.dev.commit` is unchanged and was not validated here.

Closing as superseded by merged #6454.

#6454 pins MCore to `1e3c0c62fbb79c26d083f506f7da46f5f7add49e`, which includes this PR's `de003e9932ce777e5bdcf41ed178c04c8839ec7f` plus one additional commit: NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#7152. [Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/de003e9932ce777e5bdcf41ed178c04c8839ec7f...1e3c0c62fbb79c26d083f506f7da46f5f7add49e).

Both Gemma4 fixes address NVIDIA/Megatron-LM#7709 and provide equivalent BF16/FP8/FP4 checkpoint dispatch on the new main pin. The direct `te_checkpoint` import in #6454 also preserves compatibility with our unchanged `.dev.commit` (`4a4de865795f123eda422ebf0a4c13d2418cf3cb`). This PR's unconditional `precision_aware_checkpoint` import would fail on that dev pin because the helper is absent there; this finding is based on inspection of the exact pinned source, not a full dev test run.

The merged bump also required no lockfile changes, so the unrelated package upgrades here are not needed for this MCore update. Thanks for the validation work.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=none -->

Review incomplete; no verified findings in the accessible Bridge code, regression-test change, or lockfile hunks.

The [Megatron-LM gitlink](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/0f159a49e4143f16838811ab4ba25a50b9ec79de/3rdparty/Megatron-LM) was inspected through the supplied diff, but its directory is empty in both mounted snapshots. Upstream validation cannot be completed with the available read-only tools and no network access. Consequently, I could not verify the new [checkpoint call](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/0f159a49e4143f16838811ab4ba25a50b9ec79de/src/megatron/bridge/models/gemma/modeling_gemma4.py#L1449-L1457) against the pinned helper implementation, its TE import behavior, or compatibility with the unchanged dev pin. This prevents approval of the dependency integration.

Tests were not executed, and the PR's reported runs were not independently verified. The [existing regression test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/0f159a49e4143f16838811ab4ba25a50b9ec79de/tests/unit_tests/models/gemma/test_gemma4_modeling.py#L2213-L2268) retains explicit BF16, FP8, and FP4 dispatch assertions.

No perf tests impacted.

### Suggested test cases
- `TestGemma4MoEHelpers::test_moe_layer_recompute_uses_expected_checkpoint_for_training[bf16]` — expect tensor-parallel checkpointing with activation distribution disabled, output `8.0`, and bias `None`.
- `TestGemma4MoEHelpers::test_moe_layer_recompute_uses_expected_checkpoint_for_training[fp8]` — expect TE checkpointing with the CUDA RNG tracker and `tp-group`, output `8.0`, and bias `None`.
- `TestGemma4MoEHelpers::test_moe_layer_recompute_uses_expected_checkpoint_for_training[fp4]` — expect the same TE checkpoint arguments and output assertions as FP8.
